chunks: And if they incline toward peace, then incline toward it.
He said: I said, "What is peace?" He said: "Entering into our matter."

key_terms.أَمْرِنَا: our matter, i.e. the authority and wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.السَّلْمُ: peace, interpreted here as entry into the Imams' matter

ai.seo_question: How is "And if they incline toward peace, then incline toward it" interpreted in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This report interprets the Qur'anic phrase about inclining toward peace as referring to entering into the matter of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. In this reading, true reconciliation is understood through acceptance of their authority and wilayah.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Jamhour, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Al Halby, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of the Exalted [8:61] And if they incline towards peace, then incline to it.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The entry into our<sup>asws</sup> matter (Al-Wilayah)’.
en.sarwar: 16. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Jumhur from Safwan from ibn Muskan from al-Halabi from abu ‘Abdallah about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious. “If they (the unbelievers) propose peace, accept it and trust in God. God is All-hearing and All-knowing.” [8:61].
The narrator has said, “I asked the Imam (a.s.), ‘What is the meaning of peace?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “It is the acknowledgment of our Leadership with Divine Authority.”
